description: Variation of condition 1 (time period) to extend the operation of the marquee beyond 30 September to the 23 December, for the year 2021 only of planning permission 00707/E/P107 approved 27 November 2014 for variation of condition 1 of approve planning permission 00707/E/P106 dated 29 July 2013 for change of use of garden to erect a temporary marquee every year for 10 years between 1st May and 30th September for daytime and evening private/corporate events from 2014 to 2023 inclusive, to read as follows: "The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period of nine years for the erection of a marquee from 1st May to 30th September for each consecutive year and the permission shall expire on 30th September 2023 when the use shall cease and the marquee removed within one week of that date. For 2015 only, the erection of the marquee will be extended to 31st October to cater for seven events relating to the 2015 Rugby World Cup. The site of the marquee shall be made good, levelled and laid to grass no later than one month after its removal for each yearly period".
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period of two years for the erection of the marquee from 1st May to 30th September for each consecutive year and permission shall expire on 30th September 2023 when the use shall cease and the marquee removed within one week of that date. For 2021 only, the erection and use of the marquee will be extended to 23 December 2021. The site of the marquee shall be made good, levelled and laid to grass no later than one month after its removal for each yearly period.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Received:26/07/2012: Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, Existing site plan, Proposed Site plan, Perspective view; Received: 10/05/2013: Amended elevation, Additional Statement, Appendix A,B and C; Received: 12/05/2013: Concerto group employment letter, Viewpoint photos; Received: 16/05/2013: Trip generation note and Draft Travel Plan; Received: 24/07/2014: Location Plan 01, Site Plan 02, Planning, Design and Access Statement (July 2014); Received 15/03/2021: Marquee Site, Syon Park- Site Plan 01 and Marquee Site, Syon Park- Site Plan 02.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The hereby approved development shall be constructed in accordance with the details of materials approved under application 00707/E/P107(3,7,9) dated 29/09/2015.
Condition : 4 - No excavations shall take place for the construction of, or for the purposes of the use of the marquee.

Condition : 5 - No more than 50 events shall take place per season unless agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. A list of events that have taken place shall be permanently recorded and provided to the Local Planning Authority at their request.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for marquee event purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 10am to 12 midnight Monday to Saturdays and 10am to 11pm on Sundays.
Condition : 7 - The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the car park management plan approved under application 00707/E/P107(3,7,9) dated 29/09/2015.

Condition : 8 - The travel plan (visitor welcome pack) approved as part of application 00707/E/P106 dated 29/07/2013 shall be implemented as approved and maintained throughout the life of the permission. Specifically the welcome pack shall be provided to all event visitors.

Condition : 9 - Deliveries associated with and servicing of the hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the delivery and servicing plan approved under application 00707/E/P107(3,7,9) dated 29/09/2015.
Condition : 10 - No firework displays shall take place in conjunction with any event held in or adjoining the Marquee hereby approved.

Condition : 11 - Before the marquee is first used, each year, a sound limiter (environmental noise control system) shall be installed in the marquee in accordance with details that shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to control noise levels. The sound system (or at least the power amplifier(s)) are to be permanently installed at the venue, maintained in an operational state and kept switched on at all times when amplification is used and no sound checks are to be carried out outside the permitted hours of use.

Condition : 12 - For the duration of any event to be held in the marquee, the organisers shall take measures to ensure that visitors or staff do not enter the adjacent area of nearby Site of Special Scientific interest.

Condition : 13 - Accessibility to the marquee for wheelchair users shall be provided in accordance with the specifications note in the design and access statement approved as part of application 00707/E/P106 dated 29/07/2013 and shall be maintained whilst the marquee is in use.
